export_torchscript_model: export a PyTorch model to TorchScript using trace or script mode and save to output path
optimize_for_mobile: create a MobileOptimizationConfig to apply optimize_for_mobile with CPU, Metal, or Vulkan backend
load_torchscript_model: load a saved TorchScript model from a file path and wrap it in TorchscriptWrapper
tracing_adapter_export: export a model with TracingAdapter to handle non-flattened inputs and outputs during tracing
update_export_kwargs: parse export_method trigger words like _mobile, @scripting, or @tracing to auto-set export kwargs
